summary: 大象的警报可能沿地面远距离传播。研究者从脚和耳的身体特征提出假设，再用播放地面振动的实验观察象群能否分辨信号。
logic: 从空气警报到地面振动

paragraphs.brief: 斯坦福大学博士后研究员Onell-Rodwell前往纳米比亚有史以来第一个野生动物保护区，探索神秘和复杂的大象通讯领域。
sentences: O’ Connell-Rodwell, a post-doctoral fellow at Stanford University, has traveled to Namibia’s first-ever wildlife reserve to explore the mystical and complicated realm of elephant communication.
斯坦福大学博士后研究员Onell-Rodwell前往纳米比亚有史以来第一个野生动物保护区，探索神秘和复杂的大象通讯领域。
She, along with her colleagues, is part of a scientific revolution that started almost 20 years ago.
她和她的同事一起，是近20年前开始的科学革命的一部分。

This revolution has made a stunning revelation: elephants are capable of communicating with one another over long distances by means of low-frequency sounds, also known as infrasound, which are too deep for humans to hear.
这场革命带来了惊人的启示：大象能够通过低频声音(也称为次声)进行远距离交流，这些声音太深，人类听不到。

paragraphs.brief: 因此，它可能是一个迹象，大象可以使用地震声音进行交流。
sentences: As might be expected, African elephants’ ability to detect seismic sound may have something to do with their ears.
非洲大象探测地震声的能力可能与它们的耳朵有关。
The hammer bone in an elephant’s inner ear is proportionally huge for a mammal, but it is normal for animals that use vibrational signals.
大象内耳的锤骨对哺乳动物来说成比例地巨大，但使用振动信号的动物是正常的。
Thus, it may be a sign that elephants can use seismic sounds to communicate.
因此，它可能是一个迹象，大象可以使用地震声音进行交流。

paragraphs.brief: 头骨前部充斥着鼻腔，可能起到共振室的作用，引起地面震动。
sentences: Other aspects of elephant anatomy also support this ability.
大象解剖的其他方面也支持这种能力。

First, their massive bodies, which enable them to give out low-frequency sounds almost as powerful as the sound a jet makes during take-off, serve as ideal frames for receiving ground vibrations and transmitting them to the inner ear.
首先，它们的巨大身体能够发出低频声音几乎和喷气机起飞时发出的声音一样强大成为接收地面震动并传送到内耳的理想框架
Second, the elephant’s toe bones are set in a fatty pad, which might help focus vibrations from the ground into the bone.
第二，大象的脚趾骨放在肥垫上，这可能有助于将振动从地面集中到骨头中。
Finally, the elephant has an enormous brain that sits in the cranial cavity behind the eyes, in line with the auditory canal.
最终，大象有一个巨大的大脑坐在眼后骨腔里，与听力运河一致。
The front of the skull is riddled with sinus cavities, which might function as resonating chambers for ground vibrations.
头骨前部充斥着鼻腔，可能起到共振室的作用，引起地面震动。

paragraphs.brief: 但O ' Connell-Rodwell表示，甲状腺的“听力”是用树干和脚而不是(或除耳朵外)来“听”。
sentences: It remains unclear how elephants detect such vibrations, but O’ Connell-Rodwell suggests that the pachyderms are ‘listening’ with their trunks and feet instead of (or in addition to) their ears.
但O ' Connell-Rodwell表示，甲状腺的“听力”是用树干和脚而不是(或除耳朵外)来“听”。
The elephant trunk may be the most versatile appendage in nature: it is used for drinking, bathing, smelling, feeding and scratching.
大象树干可能是大自然中最多用途的附属物：用于饮用、洗澡、嗅觉、喂养和刮伤。
Both trunk and feet contain two types of nerve endings that are sensitive to pressure—one detects infrasonic vibration and the other responds to vibrations of slightly higher frequencies.
后备箱和脚部都含有两种对压力敏感的神经末端——一种是检测次声震动，另一种是反应频率略高的振动。
As O’ Connell-Rodwell sees it, this research has a boundless and unpredictable future.
正如O ' Connell-Rodwell所看到的那样，这一研究有着无限和不可预测的未来。
‘Our work is really at the interface of geophysics, neurophysiology and ecology,’ she says.
她说神经生理学和生态学：“我们的工作其实是在地球物理学的界面。”
‘We’re raising questions that have never even been considered before.’
`我们提出以前从未被考虑过的问题'。

paragraphs.brief: 科学家早就知道，在蜘蛛、蝎子、昆虫等小动物和许多脊椎动物中，地震通信很普遍，包括白浸青蛙、盲鼠鼠、袋鼠和金鼠。
sentences: Scientists have long known that seismic communication is widespread among small animals such as spiders, scorpions, insects and many vertebrates, including white-lipped frogs, blind mole-rats, kangaroo rats and golden moles.
科学家早就知道，在蜘蛛、蝎子、昆虫等小动物和许多脊椎动物中，地震通信很普遍，包括白浸青蛙、盲鼠鼠、袋鼠和金鼠。
Nevertheless, O’ Connell-Rodwell was the first to argue that a giant land animal is also sending and receiving seismic signals.
然而，O ' Connell-Rodwell是第一个声称巨型陆地动物也发出和接收地震信号的人。

‘I used to lay a male planthopper on a stem and replay the calling sound of a female; the male would exhibit the same kind of behaviour that happens in elephants: he would freeze, press down on his legs, move forward a little, then stay still again.
”我曾经把一只雄性植物头放在干草上，重播一只雌性的声音；雄性会表现出大象身上的同样行为：他将冻僵，压压他的腿，向前一点，然后保持静止。
I found it fascinating, and it made me think that perhaps auditory communication is not the only thing going on.’
我觉得这很有趣，这让我觉得，也许听觉交流并非唯一能进行的事情。

paragraphs.brief: 科学家已经证实，远距离交流对大象的生存至关重要。在埃托沙这样的地方尤其如此：超过 2,400 头草原象活动在一片比美国新泽西州还大的区域内。
sentences: Scientists have confirmed that an elephant’s capacity to communicate over long distances is essential for survival, especially in places like Etosha, where more than 2,400 savanna elephants range over an area larger than New Jersey.
科学家已经证实，远距离交流对大象的生存至关重要。在埃托沙这样的地方尤其如此：超过 2,400 头草原象活动在一片比美国新泽西州还大的区域内。
It is already difficult for an elephant to find a mate in such a vast wilderness, and elephant reproductive biology only complicates matters.
大象在如此广阔的荒野里已经很难找到伴侣了大象的生殖生物学只会使事情复杂化
Breeding herds also adopt low-frequency sounds to warn of predators.
养殖群还采用低频声音来警告捕食者。
Even though adult elephants have no enemies other than human beings, calves are vulnerable and susceptible to attacks from lions and hyenas.
尽管成年大象除了人类之外没有敌人，小象是脆弱的，容易受到狮子和土狼的攻击。
At the sight of a predator, older herd members clump together to protect the young before running away.
在捕食者面前，年长的牧群成员聚集在一起在逃跑之前保护年轻人。

paragraphs.brief: 奥康奈尔-罗德韦尔指出：“我们 2002 年的研究结果表明，大象确实能够感知经由地面传来的警报信号。”
sentences: We now know that elephants can respond to warning calls in the air, but can they detect signals transmitted solely through the ground?
我们现在知道，大象可以对空中的警告信号作出反应，但是它们能够探测到仅仅通过地面传播的信号吗？
To investigate, the research team designed an experiment in 2002 that used electronic devices to send signals through the ground at Mushara.
为了进行调查，研究小组于2002年设计了一项实验，利用电子设备通过穆沙拉的地面发送信号。
‘The outcomes of our 2002 study revealed that elephants could indeed sense warning signals through the ground,’ O’ Connell-Rodwell observes.
奥康奈尔-罗德韦尔指出：“我们 2002 年的研究结果表明，大象确实能够感知经由地面传来的警报信号。”

paragraphs.brief: 去年，为进一步解决这一问题进行了试验。
sentences: Last year, an experiment was set up to pursue the problem further.
去年，为进一步解决这一问题进行了试验。
It used three different recordings: the 1994 warning call from Mushara, an anti-predator call recorded by scientist Joyce Poole in Kenya, and a made-up warble tone.
它使用了三种不同的录音：1994年来自Mushara的警告电话，肯尼亚科学家Joyce Poole记录的反掠夺者电话，以及一种编造的好调子。
‘The data I’ve observed so far imply that the elephants responded exactly as I expected.
我观察到的数据表明大象的反应跟我预期的完全一样。
However, the fascinating finding is that the anti-predator call from Kenya—unfamiliar to them—caused them to gather, tense up and rumble aggressively as well; but they didn’t always flee.
然而，令人着迷的是，肯尼亚的反掠夺者呼唤——他们并不熟悉—— 也使他们聚集起来，紧张起来，狂轰滥炸；但是他们并非总能逃离。
I didn’t expect the results to be that clear-cut.’
我没想到结果会这么清楚。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空最多填三个词。

items.en: According to the passage, it is determined that an elephant needs to communicate over long distances for its survival
items.zh: 根据文章，在什么情况下，大象为了生存必须进行远距离交流？
correct: 有危险的捕食者出现时。

items.en: What is the author’s attitude toward the experiment using three different recordings in the last paragraph?
items.zh: 作者对末段使用三种不同录音的实验持什么态度？
correct: The outcome is definitely out of the original expectation.
实验结果明显出乎最初的预料。

pairs: 第 4 段 · 第 1 句
第 6 段 · 第 1 句
第 5 段 · 第 1 句
points: 回到对应内容“第二，大象的脚趾骨放在肥垫上，这可能有助于将振动从地面集中到骨头中”，再按题干要求写出答案。
正确选项 A 的意思是“实验结果明显出乎最初的预料”。原文对应的是“我没想到结果会这么清楚”。
clauses: First, their massive bodies, … sounds almost as powerful as the sound a jet makes during take-off, serve as ideal frames for receiving ground vibrations and transmitting them to the inner ear.
“which enable them to give out low-frequency”修饰前面的 bodies。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 bodies，再把修饰信息接回主句。
I found it fascinating, and it made ….’
“me think that perhaps auditory communication is not the only thing going on”补足 made 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 made 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
